title: Concrete open restriction/direct-image Mayer-Vietoris diagram
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U,V open subschemes, and I a cochain complex of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write r_A for exact restriction and t_{A,W} for nested restriction, with alpha_{A,W}:r_A t_{A,W} isomorphic to r_W [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Let j_{A*} be underived module direct image. Transport Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction A.ι along Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv A to obtain a_A:r_A left adjoint to j_{A*}. Put M_A=r_A followed by j_{A*} and J_A=M_A(I), applied termwise. For W contained in A define rho_{A,W}:M_A -> M_W as the a_W-mate of alpha inverse, followed by t_{A,W} of the a_A-counit, followed by alpha. Define B=J_U direct-sum J_V, C=J_{U intersection V}, f:I -> B as the pair of the termwise a_U and a_V units, and g:B -> C as the difference of the termwise rho_{U,U intersection V} and rho_{V,U intersection V}. These are chain maps and fg=0: the two iterated units both equal the intersection unit by naturality and the left triangle identity. Define the short complex S(X,U,V,I)=(I -> B -> C) using these explicit objects, arrows and zero-composite proof. No cover, injectivity, existence theorem, or derived category is needed to define this diagram.

proof.text: Transport Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction along Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv; construct the composite restriction/direct-image functor, its termwise units, and the nested restriction transformation as the mate of the restricted counit conjugated by schemeOpenRestrictionCompIso. Naturality supplies the chain-map identities. All objects and arrows are these explicit constructions.

The generic unit_comp_mate calculation first uses homEquiv_naturality_left. Naturality of the inverse composition isomorphism and the larger adjunction left triangle identity reduce its transpose to the identity; homEquiv_id gives the smaller unit. Apply this in every degree to obtain schemeOpenModuleImage_unit_restriction and its complex version.

Define f by biprod.lift of the two units and g by biprod.desc of the overlap maps with a minus sign on V. The lift-desc formula, preservation of negation under composition, and the iterated-unit identities give unit_W minus unit_W equals zero. Use this proved equality to construct schemeMayerVietorisComplex as ShortComplex.mk.
